positive_snippets:
A neat and comfortable place to stay with clean rooms and helpful staff. The atmosphere is calm and perfect for both business and leisure travelers. I also recommend a Google 360° Virtual Tour to showcase the property and rooms on Google Maps to attract more guests.
— Karan Singh, Google Local Guide & Google-trusted 360° Virtual Tour Photographer

I have stayed many times in this property and I am extremely happy with their facilities and hospitality. The room and the washroom was very clean. The location of the property is inside from the main road but very much approachable.under a low budget that provides simple home made food. like tur daal, phulka, rice and sabzi, aloo, gobhi, paneer paratha with curd, bread omelet ect.

I stayed last week. It is located in the by lanes of Faridabad hardware market and hence easy accessable to my locations. Rooms are clean and tidy. The courtesy of hotel guys are good. Worth staying for the money paid.
negative_snippets: It's guest house type hotel. Dirty towels, messes bedsheet, not cleaned rooms. Although food is good.
